edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims and disputes between them on the terms set forth below.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. Each Party shall be responsible for its own taxes arising from this Agreement, and no amount shall be characterized as wages or salary unless required by applicable law. Each Party shall bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs, except as otherwise expressly stated in writing.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Defendant’s timely payment of the Settlement Amount, each Party, on behalf of itself and its affiliates, releases and forever discharges the other Party and its affiliates from all claims, demands, liabilities, and causes of action, known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters addressed in this Agreement, to the fullest extent permitted by law.
edits.name: release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except as required by law, regulation, or court order, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Each Party shall use reasonable efforts to ensure its representatives comply with this provision.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability by either Party.
edits.name: no_admission
